description: Week 33 (2026-11-09 to 2026-11-16; Harrison, 2026-11-09: the improvised-only folds as a safeguard, now that the speaker folds are the main protocol): the SVM probe probe30_whisper_large_v3_so4 (4c19be6604d3), its layer fixed, as classical_spk32_whisper ran it, in four classes in speaker-specific folds trained and validated on improvised utterances only (one speaker tests, all of its utterances; the other speaker of the same session validates on its improvised ones; the other eight speakers train on theirs), refitted on training plus validation; C and gamma are chosen on each fold's validation speaker as the probe chooses them. Only data.split differs from classical_spk32_whisper. Seed 1. How the results are read is fixed in RULE_week33_addendum1.txt (analyses/week33_prep_20261109) before any run. Runs on CPUs.
